subject: ArborPath connector: safety hardening runbook & verification checklist
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@arborpath.io>, ops@arborpath.io
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: ArborPath connector: safety hardening runbook & verification checklist

Hi Elaine —

Thanks again for walking through the initial adapter last week. Attached is a draft runbook (arborpath-connectors-runbook-v1.pdf) with the safety hardening steps we discussed:

- configuration matrix (network, auth, KMS)
- KV-cache compatibility test steps
- failure/fallback scenarios and graceful-degradation policy
- tokenization/embedding validation checklist
- suggested smoke tests and pass/fail criteria

Can you review the runbook and confirm:
1) whether ArborPath can run the KV-cache test in your sandbox (we listed the exact payloads and sample sessions),
2) any additional network constraints we should add, and
3) a 2-hour window next week for an execution run with both teams on the call.

Sergio / Kim — looping you in for any redlines on the fallback policy or telemetry hooks we should add. If this looks good I'll open a Jira ticket and share a Drive folder with the test artifacts.

Happy to adjust the runbook — goal is to hand off a safe-to-run checklist ArborPath can own for the POC.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin | Partner Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: arborpath-connectors-runbook-v1.pdf
From: Elaine Park <elaine@arborpath.io>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@arborpath.io, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ArborPath connector: safety hardening runbook & verification checklist

Thanks Marcus — this is great and much more actionable than the initial doc. A few quick notes after a first pass: 

> - KV-cache compatibility test steps

We can run the KV-cache test in our sandbox but need the exact Redis/kv-store client version matrix you expect (we run Redis 7.0 in staging, client: hiredis 1.0.1). The sample payloads you included look fine.

> - suggested smoke tests and pass/fail criteria

Two clarifications: 1) for latency SLOs we need to confirm the request shapes for short/long sequences (you list 64 and 2048 tokens; we use 32/1024 in our tracing), and 2) we prefer a non-destructive rerun flag for the embedding regression tests (so we can validate without polluting production indices).

Proposed times for the 2-hour run: Tue 2026-12-01 13:00-15:00 PT or Wed 2026-12-02 09:00-11:00 PT. Either works for our infra folks.

I'm attaching an initial scan we ran against the adapter (arborpath-scan-results-20261130.csv) — it flags two items under TLS negotiation that we'll want you to confirm.

- Elaine
Elaine Park | Partner Technical Lead
ArborPath, Inc.
elaine@arborpath.io | +1 617-555-0115

Attachment: arborpath-scan-results-20261130.csv
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine@arborpath.io>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ArborPath connector: safety hardening runbook & verification checklist

Marcus / Kim — quick internal note before we lock times with ArborPath: 

- KV-cache test: Marcus, can you add the Redis client matrix and our expected client behavior (timeouts, reconnect backoff) to section 2.1? Elaine called out hiredis 1.0.1 — include that and a note about our preferred connection pool sizing.
- TLS negotiation flags: Kim, please confirm whether the runtime will accept the TLS ciphers ArborPath flagged; if not we should propose a supported ciphers list they can enable.
- Non-destructive rerun: agree we should provide a flag; Sergio suggests a `--dry-index` mode in the test harness that writes to a temporary index and removes it after validation.

I'll be available for the Wed 09:00-11:00 PT window if we choose that — otherwise Tue afternoon also works. Marcus, once you add the Redis/client details I can author the Jira ticket and link infra runbooks.

Sergio
Sergio Alvarez | Solutions Architect, Alliances
Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@arborpath.io>, ops@arborpath.io
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2026 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ArborPath connector: safety hardening runbook & verification checklist

Thanks everyone — locking in Wed 2026-12-02 09:00-11:00 PT. Agenda and pre-reads are below.

Agenda (2 hours):
1) Quick intro and success criteria (10m)
2) Runbook walkthrough (20m) — Marcus
3) KV-cache compatibility test & client matrix (30m) — live run with ArborPath (/dry-index mode)
4) TLS negotiation review and remediation steps (20m)
5) Smoke tests and telemetry verification (30m)
6) Next steps and Jira assignment (10m)

Pre-reads and artifacts:
- Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0BzArborPath/connector-runbooks
- Runbook: arborpath-connectors-runbook-v1.pdf (attached)
- Scan results: arborpath-scan-results-20261130.csv (attached)
- Safety checklist (finalized post-run): arborpath-safety-checklist-20261202.xlsx (will attach after call)
- Jira: JIRA-OPS-9876 (I created the ticket and assigned initial tasks to Sergio and ArborPath ops)

Action items before the call:
- Marcus: add Redis client matrix and connection pool guidance (doing now).
- Kim: confirm supported TLS ciphers and paste list into the Drive checklist.
- Elaine / ArborPath ops: confirm Wed 09:00 PT attendee list and provide any additional constraints.

Thanks — see you on Wed.

Marcus

Redwood Inference
